units.literal: Jingtang was afraid; his staff officer Duan Xiyao requested executing the ringleaders; Jingtang ordered Liu Zhiyuan to behead thirty-six men as a warning.

units.zh: 時租庸使趙岩勸帝郊天，且言：「帝王受命，須行此禮，願陛下力行之。」
units.en: Rent and Corvée commissioner Zhao Yan urged Heaven-sacrifice, saying: "Emperors who receive the Mandate must perform this rite—Your Majesty should see it through."
units.literal: At the time Rent and Corvée commissioner Zhao Yan urged the Emperor to sacrifice to Heaven, saying: "When emperors receive the Mandate they must perform this rite; Your Majesty should exert yourself to carry it out."

units.zh: 十二月，晉王自太原復至魏州。
units.en: In the twelfth month the Prince of Jin returned from Taiyuan to Weizhou.
units.literal: In the twelfth month the Prince of Jin came again from Taiyuan to Weizhou.

units.zh: 己巳，帝幸洛陽，為來年有事於南郊也。
units.en: On jisi the Emperor went to Luoyang to prepare for a Southern Suburban rite the following year.
units.literal: On jisi the Emperor visited Luoyang, because next year there would be affairs at the Southern Suburban Altar.

units.zh: 三年，契丹率眾屯邯鄲，遇與安審琦、慕容彥超等禦之。
units.en: In the third year the Khitans massed at Handan, and Huang Fuyu, An Shenqi, Murong Yanchao, and others went out to oppose them.
units.literal: In the third year the Khitans led their masses to encamp at Handan; Yu, together with An Shenqi, Murong Yanchao, and others, resisted them.

units.zh: 杜知敏已為所獲，遇謂彥超曰：「知敏蒼黃之中，以馬授我，義也，安可使陷於賊中！」
units.en: Du Zhimin had already been taken. Huang Fuyu said to Yanchao, "In the heat of battle Zhimin gave me his horse — that was an act of loyalty. We cannot leave him in enemy hands!"
units.literal: Du Zhimin had already been captured; Yu said to Yanchao, "In the midst of confusion Zhimin gave me his horse — that was righteousness. How can we let him fall into the hands of the enemy!"

units.zh: 遂與彥超躍馬取知敏而還，敵騎壯之。
units.en: He and Yanchao then spurred their horses forward, snatched Zhimin back, and returned; the enemy horsemen were impressed.
units.literal: He and Yanchao then spurred their horses, seized Zhimin, and returned; the enemy cavalry admired this.

units.zh: 遇與彥超中數創得還，時諸軍嘆曰：「此三人皆猛將也！」
units.en: Huang Fuyu and Yanchao returned with several wounds; the armies at the time exclaimed, "These three are fierce generals!"
units.literal: Yu and Yanchao received several wounds but got back; at the time the various armies exclaimed, "These three are fierce generals!"

units.zh: 以翰林承旨、兵部尚書、知制誥盧質為檢校司空，充同州節度使。
units.en: Lu Zhi, Hanlin edict-drafter and War minister, became acting Minister of Works and Tong commissioner.
units.literal: Hanlin edict-drafter, Minister of War, and edict drafter Lu Zhi was made acting Grand Preceptor and Tongzhou military commissioner.

units.zh: 時李嗣源總帳下親軍攻東北隅；
units.en: Li Siyuan led the household guard against the northeast corner;
units.literal: Li Siyuan commanded the personal troops below the tent attacking the northeast corner;

units.zh: 李嗣源壞夾城東北隅，率先掩擊，梁軍大恐，南向而奔，投戈委甲，噎塞行路，斬萬餘級，獲其將副招討使符道昭洎大將三百人，芻粟百萬。
units.en: Li Siyuan breached Jiacity's northeast and charged in; Liang panicked and fled south, shedding arms until the road jammed; over ten thousand were killed; Fu Daozhao and three hundred officers were taken, with a million bundles of fodder.
units.literal: Li Siyuan broke the northeast corner of Jiacity and led the assault; the Liang army was greatly terrified and fled south, casting weapons and armor; the road was choked; more than ten thousand were beheaded; deputy pacification commissioner Fu Daozhao and three hundred great generals were captured, and a million measures of fodder.

units.zh: 五月辛未朔，晨霧晦暝，帝率親軍伏三垂崗下。
units.en: At the xinwei new moon in the fifth month, thick morning fog hid Cunxu's personal troops below Sanchui Ridge.
units.literal: On the first day xinwei of the fifth month, morning fog dark and dim, the Emperor led his personal army in ambush below Sanchui Ridge.

units.zh: 詔侍衛步軍都指揮使曹英權知鎮州軍府事。
units.en: An edict named Palace Foot Guards commander Cao Ying acting overseer of Zhenzhou.
units.literal: An edict ordered Cao Ying, commander-in-chief of the Palace Foot Guards, to act as overseer of Zhenzhou military administration.

units.zh: 庚寅，鎮州節度使何福進奏乞朝覲，三奏，允之。
units.en: On gengyin Zhenzhou military governor He Fujin petitioned three times for an audience and was granted permission.
units.literal: On gengyin, He Fujin, military governor of Zhenzhou, memorialized requesting an audience at court; after three memorials permission was granted.

units.zh: 時嗣源遙領鎮州，詰旦，議欲歸藩，上章請罪，安重誨以為不可，語在《明宗紀》中。
units.en: Siyuan still held Zhen at a distance; at dawn he debated returning to his post and asked punishment; An Chonghui forbade it—the account is in the 《Mingzong Annals》.
units.literal: At the time Siyuan held Zhenzhou at a distance; at dawn he debated returning to his circuit and submitted a memorial asking punishment; An Chonghui held it impossible—the account is in the 《Mingzong Annals》.

units.zh: 甲申，以皇子澶州節度使榮為開封尹兼功德使，封晉王，仍令所司擇日備禮冊命。
units.en: On jiashen Prince Rong, Chanzhou military governor, was named Kaifeng mayor and merit commissioner, enfeoffed Prince of Jin, with orders to schedule his formal investiture.
units.literal: On jiashen, the imperial son Rong, military governor of Chanzhou, was made Mayor of Kaifeng and concurrently Merit Commissioner, enfeoffed as Prince of Jin, and the responsible offices were ordered to choose a day and prepare the ritual investiture.
